name: tome-of-abyssal-heaven-other-weapon-has-spellshroud-tome-itself-targetable
notes: Tome of Abyssal Heaven: "Other objects you control have spellshroud" -- shrouds the other weapon, not itself. Tome of Abyssal Heaven (igmC01eEZn, REGALIA/ITEM): "Other objects you control have spellshroud." -- an unconditional static grant; it was not implemented anywhere (no HasSpellshroud() clause). Fixed: HasSpellshroud() returns true for any field object whose controller controls an ability-bearing Tome (other than the Tome itself). Player 2 controls the Tome and a Mirrordepth's Blade; player 1 plays Fracturize: the target prompt offers ONLY the Tome (theirField-1) -- the Blade (theirField-2) is shrouded and answering with it is refused -- and the Tome, which only grants spellshroud to OTHER objects, is a legal target and becomes a phantasia.

rulesClauses: Tome of Abyssal Heaven: other objects you control have spellshroud (the Tome itself does not).

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Tome of Abyssal Heaven's static "Other objects you control have spellshroud." was not implemented anywhere (no clause in HasSpellshroud()). Evidence on HEAD 48faaae9 (this fixture, run against the unfixed Custom/GameLogic.php): player 1's spell target prompt was 'MZCHOOSE:theirField-1&theirField-2' -- the other object was offered. Fix: HasSpellshroud() returns true for any field object whose controller controls an ability-bearing Tome (excluding the Tome itself), after the HasNoAbilities / NO_SPELLSHROUD gates.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php HasSpellshroud() (no entry for igmC01eEZn; no generated HasKeyword_Spellshroud table)
